answer: At the registry inlet, every agent must lock 100 tokens for 30 days to receive ten job bids per hourly pulse. Creating a thousand identities therefore ties up 100,000 tokens; splitting the same stake among more names buys no extra bids. The registry treats an old reputation badge as a relic, never as a substitute for the bond. Sybils remain possible, but their bidding capacity costs the attacker locked capital in direct proportion to scale.
